div.p: A realistic analytical journey and how selections synchronize the scientific views

ul.li: Cross-species MSA compares one primary protein per species.
Isoform Alignment compares isoforms only within the selected species.
Species selection drives all species-specific views.

div.p: Domain Architecture and Boundary views require completed InterProScan / pyTMHMM; before that they show a calm pending state. Cross-species MSA appears only for multi-species datasets.

g.text: 6 - Select an exploratory or validated event
